value.meaning:
(14) “Dwelling
unit” means a structure or the part of a structure that is used as a home,
residence or sleeping place by one person who maintains a household or by two
or more persons who maintain a common household. “Dwelling unit” regarding a
person who rents a space for a manufactured dwelling or recreational vehicle or
regarding a person who rents moorage space for a floating home as defined in
ORS 830.700, but does not rent the home, means the space rented and not the
manufactured dwelling, recreational vehicle or floating home itself.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(16) “Facility”
means a manufactured dwelling park or a marina.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(21) “Good faith”
means honesty in fact in the conduct of the transaction concerned.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(25) “Landlord”
means the owner, lessor or sublessor of the dwelling unit or the building or
premises of which it is a part. “Landlord” includes a person who is authorized
by the owner, lessor or sublessor to manage the premises or to enter into a
rental agreement.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(26) “Landlord’s
agent” means a person who has oral or written authority, either express or
implied, to act for or on behalf of a landlord.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(28) “Manufactured
dwelling” means a residential trailer, a mobile home or a manufactured home as
those terms are defined in ORS 446.003 or a prefabricated structure. “Manufactured
dwelling” includes an accessory building or structure.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(29) “Manufactured
dwelling park” means a place where four or more manufactured dwellings are
located, the primary purpose of which is to rent space or keep space for rent
to any person for a charge or fee.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(30) “Marina”
means a moorage of contiguous dwelling units that may be legally transferred as
a single unit and are owned by one person where four or more floating homes are
secured, the primary purpose of which is to rent space or keep space for rent
to any person for a charge or fee.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(37) “Premises”
means:
(a) A dwelling
unit and the structure of which it is a part and facilities and appurtenances
therein;
(b) Grounds,
areas and facilities held out for the use of tenants generally or the use of
which is promised to the tenant; and
(c) A facility
for manufactured dwellings or floating homes.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(41)(a) “Rent”
means any payment to be made to the landlord under the rental agreement,
periodic or otherwise, in exchange for the right of a tenant and any permitted
pet to occupy a dwelling unit to the exclusion of others and to use the
premises.
(b) “Rent” does
not include security deposits, fees or utility or service charges as described
in ORS 90.315 (4) and 90.562.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(42) “Rental
agreement” means all agreements, written or oral, and valid rules and
regulations adopted under ORS 90.262 or 90.510 (6) embodying the terms and
conditions concerning the use and occupancy of a dwelling unit and premises. “Rental
agreement” includes a lease. A rental agreement is either a week-to-week
tenancy, month-to-month tenancy or fixed term tenancy.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(51) “Tenant”:
(a) Except as
provided in paragraph (b) of this subsection:
(A) Means a
person, including a roomer, entitled under a rental agreement to occupy a
dwelling unit to the exclusion of others, including a dwelling unit owned,
operated or controlled by a public housing authority.
(B) Means a
minor, as defined and provided for in ORS 109.697.
(b) For purposes
of ORS 90.505 to 90.850, means only a person who owns and occupies as a
residence a manufactured dwelling or a floating home in a facility and persons
residing with that tenant under the terms of the rental agreement.
(c) Does not mean
a guest or temporary occupant.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

value.meaning:
(56) “Week-to-week
tenancy” means a tenancy that has all of the following characteristics:
(a) Occupancy is
charged on a weekly basis and is payable no less frequently than every seven
days;
(b) There is a
written rental agreement that defines the landlord’s and the tenant’s rights
and responsibilities under this chapter; and
(c) There are no
fees or security deposits, although the landlord may require the payment of an
applicant screening charge, as provided in ORS 90.295.
value.scope: Chapter90 unless context otherwise requires; preserve special subpart qualifiers in this definition

records.email_notice_conditions.required.value:
THIS
IS AN IMPORTANT NOTICE
ABOUT
YOUR RIGHTS REGARDING
RECEIPT
OF WRITTEN NOTICES.
By signing this
addendum, you agree to receive written notices from your landlord by e-mail.
This may include important legal notices, including rent increase and tenancy
termination notices. Failure to read or respond to a written notice could
result in you losing your housing or being unaware of a change in rent. Signing
this addendum is voluntary. Only agree to service of written notices
electronically if you check your e-mail regularly.
______________________________________________________________________________
